scientific_integrity: Analytical proof for every allowed dimension and weight. Exact finite checker is corroborative and not an infinite certificate. Foundational simplex-sum constructions and general polytope representations are credited to their sources.
scientific_limitations: Only length-homogeneous nonnegative cyclic interval simplex weights; independent mathematical validation and exhaustive bibliographic priority assessment have not been performed.
title: Mean-length Minkowski asymmetry for weighted cyclic simplex sums
